meta.name: macos-menubar-tuist-app
meta.description: Build, refactor, or review macOS menubar apps that use Tuist and SwiftUI. Use when creating or maintaining LSUIElement menubar utilities, defining Tuist targets/manifests, implementing model-client-store-view architecture, adding script-based launch flows, or validating reliable local build/run behavior without Xcode-first workflows.

copy.tagline: 构建、重构或审查 macOS 菜单栏应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在用 Tuist 和 SwiftUI 开发 macOS 菜单栏应用。
copy.tagline_en: Build, refactor, or review macOS menubar apps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you develop macOS menubar apps with Tuist and SwiftUI.

howto.what: 帮你用 Tuist 和 SwiftUI 构建、重构或审查 macOS 菜单栏应用。它会保持 LSUIElement 为 true，把网络、状态和 UI 分离到不同文件，并生成可运行的脚本。
howto.when: 当你创建或维护 macOS 菜单栏工具，定义 Tuist 目标/清单，实现模型-客户端-存储-视图架构，添加脚本启动流程，或验证本地构建/运行行为时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个菜单栏应用，用 Tuist 管理，显示当前天气。
say.note: 它会生成 Project.swift 和分层文件结构。

say.text: 给这个菜单栏应用添加一个刷新按钮，数据从 API 获取。
say.note: 它会更新 store 和 client 层，不修改视图逻辑。

say.text: 检查这个菜单栏应用的构建脚本，确保不打开 Xcode。
say.note: 它会验证 run-menubar.sh 并建议修改。

howto.what_en: Helps you build, refactor, or review macOS menubar apps using Tuist and SwiftUI. It keeps LSUIElement true, separates networking, state, and UI into different files, and generates runnable scripts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when creating or maintaining macOS menubar utilities, defining Tuist targets/manifests, implementing model-client-store-view architecture, adding script-based launch flows, or validating local build/run behavior.

say_en.text: Create a menubar app with Tuist that shows current weather.
say_en.note: It will generate Project.swift and layered file structure.

say_en.text: Add a refresh button to this menubar app, fetching data from an API.
say_en.note: It will update store and client layers without touching views.

say_en.text: Check the build script for this menubar app to ensure it doesn't open Xcode.
say_en.note: It will verify run-menubar.sh and suggest fixes.
